verdict.rationale: Offer letters and HR-document e-signature are a fair axis for a payroll/HR platform like Gusto, but the evidence pack never documents sending offer letters or documents for e-signature, or storing documents per employee. The only related items cover employee tax-information onboarding and batch employee creation, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee
